title: EPAM is excluded on non-EU enterprise scale despite appearing in both the Flowable and Camunda lists
content:
EPAM Systems is in the Flowable Partner Finder and is marked do-not-pitch on two grounds recorded together: a non-EU base and enterprise scale. The flag adds that it is a dual listing, holding Camunda Silver as well.

The dual listing is the more transferable observation. When a firm carries formal partnerships with two competing BPM engines, the engine is a skill in a service catalogue rather than a strategic bet, and its listing says nothing about where its delivery weight sits. That is a general caution about using vendor directories as evidence of commitment, not just a fact about EPAM.

The overlap also concentrates in a predictable place. Tata Consultancy Services carries Camunda Gold alongside its Flowable entry, and both firms are excluded from this brief on scale — so the directories agree most about exactly the firms the brief has already ruled out. Screening a partner directory by size before reading its tiers avoids spending attention on that overlap.
